entities.summary: Julio, a notable figure in the history of Uruguay, associated with Democratic Restoration and the Progressive Model (1985–2005). Preceded by Democracy restored. Their legacy influenced Frente Amplio wins presidency for the first time and José Mujica inaugurated as president.
